snippet.title: 1 Bouncing Ball Drops Every Second to Destroy 4000+ Blocks! Satisfying Chain Reaction Simulation
snippet.description:
Watch what happens when a new bouncing ball drops every second into a massive tower of over 4000 blocks!

Every time a block is destroyed, it spawns a brand new bouncing ball! This triggers an exponential chain reaction where the balls multiply completely out of control. Every block collision generates relaxing ASMR sounds, turning the visual chaos into the ultimate oddly satisfying physics simulation.

Wait for the perfectly satisfying freefall screen clear at the end!

#satisfying #chainreaction #asmr #simulation
